description: This file is a shell script that contains a test suite for cherry-picking and reverting commits in a git repository. It defines test scenarios, sets up initial commits, performs cherry-pick and revert operations, and verifies the results.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success, with a given description and commands.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock to simulate time passing between commits.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files to verify they are identical.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that a specified file does not exist.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Verifies that a command fails as expected.
